app.name: AncestorsTree
app.tagline: Build your family tree together and never miss a death anniversary.
app.description: AncestorsTree — build your family tree together and never miss a death anniversary.

home.title: Your family tree, one photo at a time.
home.legend: Threads with a red pin join parents to children · stitches join spouses · the line under a name is the death anniversary (lunar) · cake stickers are birthdays.

notFound.title: We could not find this page
notFound.body: The link may be outdated or mistyped.

routeError.title: Something went wrong on this page
routeError.body: Reload the page. If it keeps failing, go back to the home page.

designGallery.title: Design system
designGallery.intro: Every color, typeface and component of AncestorsTree in one place. Switch between light and dark at the top to see both.

type.body: Each person is a photo. The color of the tape shows which branch they belong to.
type.hand: Grandpa's memorial is on the full moon of the tenth month

controls.nameHint: Write it in full, with diacritics. Example: Nguyễn Văn Thịnh.
controls.dateError: The tenth lunar month of that year has only 29 days.

dialog.title: Remove Cô Hà from the tree?
dialog.body: Cô Hà will be moved to “Loose photos”. You can undo right after.

marks.note: Death anniversaries (lunar) are a quiet line under the name; cake stickers are birthdays.

threads.note: Threads with a red pin join parents to children. Stitches with a round knot join spouses.

serverStatus.databaseDown: The server is running (version {{version}}) but cannot reach the database

errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: Some data is invalid. Please check it.
errors.INVALID_TOKEN: This link no longer works: it is wrong, expired or already used.
errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: The email or password is wrong.
errors.EMAIL_TAKEN: This email already has an account. Sign in or reset your password.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.NOT_FOUND: We could not find what you were looking for.
errors.VERSION_CONFLICT: Someone else just updated the family tree.
errors.RULE_VIOLATION: This change is not valid for the family tree.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

errors.passwordTooLong: This password is too long (72 bytes at most)

login.title: Sign in
login.googleFailed: Google sign-in did not work. Try again, or use your email and password.

forgot.title: Forgot your password
forgot.intro: Enter your email. We will send a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If this email has an account, a reset link is on its way. The link works once, for 1 hour.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.missing: This link has no reset code. Open the link in the email again, or get a new one.

clans.title: My family trees
clans.empty: You are not in any family tree yet. Create your first one, or open an invite link a relative sent you.

members.removeBody: {{name}} will no longer be able to view or edit this family tree. Invite links created before now will no longer let them join; to bring them back, create a new link.
members.leaveBody: You will no longer see this family tree until someone invites you again.

invites.title: Invite links
invites.intro: Anyone with the link can join within 7 days. Send it to relatives through Zalo or Messenger.
invites.copyFailed: Could not copy, please copy the link manually

join.title: Family tree invitation
join.forbidden: You cannot join this family tree with this link. Ask the manager for a new invitation.

board.label: Family tree: {{name}}
board.noProgenitor: No progenitor has been chosen yet. The Manager chooses one under “Not yet linked” below.

rules.INVALID_ID: An id is not valid. Reload the page and try again.
rules.DUPLICATE_ID: This id is already used. Reload the page and try again.
rules.PERSON_NOT_FOUND: This person is no longer in the family tree.
rules.UNION_NOT_FOUND: This marriage is no longer in the family tree.
rules.PERSON_HAS_CHILDREN: A person who still has children cannot be deleted. Detach or move the children first.
rules.UNION_HAS_CHILDREN: A marriage that still has children cannot be deleted. Detach or move the children first.
rules.PROGENITOR_PROTECTED: The progenitor cannot be deleted. Choose another progenitor first.
rules.CYCLE: This change would make someone their own ancestor.
rules.INVALID_PARTNERS: A marriage needs one or two different people.
rules.RESTORE_CONFLICT: Cannot restore: this person's marriage has changed.
rules.TREE_FULL: The family tree already has 5,000 people; no more can be added.

tree.empty: No one is in this family tree yet.

unlinked.title: Not yet linked
unlinked.hint: These people are not linked to the progenitor yet, so they are not on the chart.

notice.reloaded: The latest version of the family tree was reloaded from the server; your unsaved changes were dropped.
notice.signedOut: Your session has expired. Sign in again to save your changes.
